title: Standing
description: Whether a converged account can be used yet, and who is waited on. Observed, never desired. Present on a subject or an apply outcome if and only if an account exists on the target.

usable.description: The account can be used right now.

waiting_on.description: Who must act before it is usable.

note.description: Why, in the add-on's words, e.g. 'No password set yet'.

next.description: What the person waited on does next.
